title: A conversation in glass
alt: A porcelain lamp and glass sunflower share a dark console against a pale blue wall.
description: Two independent object references brought into one product photograph with coordinated light.

frames.label: Input 1
frames.alt: A translucent porcelain petal shade glows above a terracotta base and a slim brass stem.
frames.prompt: An extraordinary premium product photograph of a sculptural table lamp inspired by a folded petal. Its broad translucent ivory porcelain shade curves gracefully around a warm concealed light source, supported by a single continuous slender dark-brass stem that rises from a low terracotta ceramic base. Fine porcelain translucency, subtle hand-shaped edges, precisely connected shade, stem and base, delicate warm light spilling onto a dark slate table. A softly textured pale-blue wall behind it creates a refined cool-warm contrast. Beautiful asymmetrical industrial design, convincing physical construction and exquisite material detail, no words or lettering.

frames.label: Input 2
frames.alt: An amber glass sunflower with two green leaves casts colored light onto a dark stone surface.
frames.prompt: A spectacular museum photograph of a single life-size sunflower made entirely from transparent amber and pale-green cut glass. Exactly one circular central seed head is surrounded by a coherent radial ring of glass petals; one continuous green glass stem has exactly two broad serrated leaves and rises from a clear faceted geometric base. Fine internal bubbles and polished faceted edges, physically convincing refraction, a luminous amber caustic projected onto the dark gray stone beneath it. Restrained warm side light, no other flowers, exquisite precision and balanced vertical composition, no text.

frames.label: Result
frames.alt: A porcelain lamp and glass sunflower share a dark console against a pale blue wall.
frames.prompt: Create a sophisticated product photograph combining the two supplied objects without changing their designs. On the LEFT place the porcelain lamp from image 1, retaining its ivory petal shade, single brass stem and terracotta base. On the RIGHT place the glass sunflower from image 2, retaining its amber flower head, green stem, exactly two leaves and faceted clear base. Both complete objects stand separately on a dark slate console against a softly lit pale-blue wall. The lamp is lit and its light reflects naturally in the glass flower. No additional lamps, flowers, objects or lettering.
